dedupe_keys.name: cmip6 climate projections copernicus climate data store

description: This Climate Data Store entry provides daily and monthly global climate projections from many experiments, models and periods of the sixth phase of the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project (CMIP6), which underpins the IPCC Sixth Assessment Report. It contains historical experiments, typically 1850 to 2014, and scenario projections combining Shared Socioeconomic Pathways and Representative Concentration Pathways, typically 2015 to 2100, with two- and three-dimensional variables such as temperature, precipitation and wind. The data are produced by the participating modelling institutes and served by the Copernicus Climate Change Service, which runs subsetting in the Earth System Grid Federation nodes where the data are held. Coverage is global at each model's native grid, from 1850 to 2100 and for some experiments to 2300. Access is through the CDS web form and API after free registration, under the CMIP6 data access terms of use, at no cost. Caveats: model grids are coarse (often 100 km or more), models differ in bias and sensitivity, so ensembles and bias adjustment are needed, and the set of models offered is a subset of CMIP6. It supplies scenario forcing for climate adaptation and future hazard exposure studies of infrastructure; related records are ERA5, ISIMIP, NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 and the Aqueduct flood hazard maps.
